statement: let W := fun (z y s : ℕ) => let P := (Finset.Ico z y).filter Nat.Prime; (2:ℤ)-((P.filter (fun p => p∣s)).card:ℤ)-((P.filter (fun p => p^2∣s)).card:ℤ); ∀ (n z y s r : ℕ), 2 ≤ z → z < y → 2 ≤ s → s < n → (∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime → (p ∣ s) → z ≤ p) → n ≤ y^(r+1) → n ≤ z*y^r → 0 < W z y s → s.primeFactorsList.length ≤ r

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖第三批 · FR-9017 · 将 1+4 的正权因子数判据推广到一般因子数预算
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage III · FR-9017 · Extend the one-plus-four positive-weight support test to a general factor cap

brief.zh: 按重数分解 s。正权最多允许一个位于 [z,y) 的素因子且只出现一次，其余因子均不小于 y。r=2 和 r=3 给下侧加权筛的具体参数条件。
brief.en: Factor s with multiplicity. Positive weight permits at most one prime factor in [z,y), with exponent one. All other factors are at least y. The cases r=2 and r=3 give concrete parameter constraints for the lower-range sieve.
